rules.detects: the main of a binary's root: src/main.rs, src/bin/x.rs, src/bin/x/main.rs, or a [[bin]] path any Cargo.toml in the project names
the main of a crate's build.rs, which Cargo runs before it compiles the crate
a handler a router's .route("/path", …) names: get(handler), post(handler) and the rest (axum), or .to(handler) (actix-web)
a function carrying #[no_mangle], #[unsafe(no_mangle)], #[export_name = …] or #[wasm_bindgen], which code outside Rust calls by name

entrances.notDetected: a router built in a helper and merged in, a route macro of another framework (warp filters, poem), a trait a framework calls (a tonic gRPC service, a tower Service), a message consumer and a proc-macro are not detected

ladder.because: rustc refuses a path to an item from outside its visibility scope (private: its module and descendants; pub(super)/pub(in …): that module's subtree), so an item whose effective visibility stops short of the crate cannot be referenced from outside that scope

rungs.fact: the protected item's effective visibility (its own and every enclosing module's) stops short of the crate root, so rustc refuses any reference from outside that scope

rungs.enforcer: Coherence's check at the edit and in CI
rungs.fact: the item is pub(crate) or pub and reachable crate-wide, and every resolved reference in the workspace is inside the chokepoint
